abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate outcomes of onco-testis sperm extraction (TESE) and to define potential predictors of successful surgical sperm retrieval (SSR). METHODS: For this study, we examined all men (i) diagnosed with a testicular mass, (ii) who had azoospermia, and (iii) who underwent a radical orchiectomy and onco-TESE. Our institutional database of testicular cancer (TCA) patients was reviewed. Demographics, baseline endocrine and oncological characteristics, and treatments received were recorded. The onco-TESE Technique was performed at the time of radical orchiectomy before the specimen was sent for formal histopathological assessment. Onco-TESE was considered successful if viable sperm was found. Logistic regression assessments were performed to evaluate predictors of successful onco-TESE. RESULTS: Thirty-eight men with a median age of 35 were included in the analysis. Median baseline total testosterone, LH, and FSH levels were 419ng/dL, 10.9mU/mL, and 27mU/mL, respectively. The median pre-TESE testicular volume was 11 mL. Of men who underwent radical orchiectomy, 58% had unilateral tumors at the time of the procedure. 42% had bilateral tumors, which were synchronous in 25%, and asynchronous tumors in 75%. Pathologically, 76% had germ cell tumor (83% had pure seminoma, and 17% had mixed germ cell tumor). At onco-TESE, 24% of the patients had successful SSR. No variables had a statistically significant association with successful SSR. CONCLUSION: Onco-TESE represents a useful option for testis cancer patients who wish for future paternity, with a quarter of such patients having sperm found.
abstract_ja: 目的:腫瘍精巣精子抽出(TESE)の転帰を評価し、成功した外科的精子回収(SSR)の潜在的予測因子を定義すること。方法:本研究では、(i)精巣腫瘤と診断された、(ii)無精子症を有する、および(iii)根治的精巣摘除術と腫瘍TESE を受けた全ての男性を検査した。当施設の精巣がん患者データベースをレビューした。人口統計学的、基礎内分泌および腫瘍学的特性、および受けた治療を記録した。腫瘍TESE技術は根治的精巣摘除術時に試料が正式な病理組織学的検査に送付される前に施行された。腫瘍TESEは実行可能な精子が見つかった場合に成功と考えられた。ロジスティック回帰分析を行い、成功した腫瘍TESEの予測因子を評価した。結果:中央年齢35歳の38人の男性を分析に含めた。基礎テストステロン、LH、FSHレベルの中央値はそれぞれ419 ng/dL、10.9 mU/mL、27 mU/mLであった。TESE前の精巣容積の中央値は11 mLであった。根治的精巣摘除術を受けた男性の58%は手術時に一側性腫瘍を有していた。42%は両側性腫瘍を有し、その25%は同時性、75%は非同時性腫瘍であった。病理学的に、76%は胚細胞腫瘍を有していた(83%は純粋なセミノーマ、17%は混合型胚細胞腫瘍)。腫瘍TESE で、24%の患者は成功したSSRを有していた。成功したSSRと統計的に有意な関連を有する変数はなかった。結論:腫瘍TESEは将来の父性を望む精巣がん患者のための有用な選択肢を表し、そのような患者の4分の1が精子を見つけた。
